channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: No-parking zone in Nancy Guthrie’s neighborhood widened amid complaints about journalists, streamers
item.description: The new restrictions take effect Thursday.

item.title: California’s reading reforms drive push for better math skills in early grades
item.description: It’s a process that California should adopt for all of its persistent issues, rather than the scattergun approach officialdom tends to take.

item.title: Car enthusiasts gather for coffee and fun in Grand Terrace
item.description: Each month on the third Saturday the group gathers in the Walgreens parking lot.

item.title: USC women can’t hold off Kiyomi McMiller, Penn State’s efficient shooters
item.description: Kara Dunn has 24 points and Jazzy Davidson scores 22 for the Trojans, but McMiller scores a career-high 40 and makes seven 3-pointers as Penn State shoots 62% and rallies for an 85-82 win.

item.title: Woman, 20, accused of fatally shooting San Bernardino woman in her home after fight
item.description: Police asked for the public's help finding the woman they believe shot the victim.

item.title: High-speed police chase ends in fatal collision in Rialto
item.description: Emanuel Ayala had 30 prior arrests, including auto theft and evading police, before allegedly killing a man after running a red light in a stolen SUV.

item.title: Singer D4vd is ‘target’ in investigation of killing of girl whose body was found in car in Hollywood
item.description: The body of Celeste Rivas Hernandez, of Lake Elsinore, was found on Sept. 8.

item.title: Update on Moreno Valley Mall’s closure planned at special meeting
item.description: The public can address city council members and hear reports from officials.

item.title: Vegas spoils Artemi Panarin’s Kings debut with 5-goal 3rd period
item.description: The Kings take a one-goal lead into the final frame, but the Golden Knights, playing without five players who participated in the Olympic gold-medal game on Sunday, score five goals in the final 12 minutes to hand the hosts a 6-4 defeat.

item.title: Ducks rally past Oilers to give Joel Quenneville his 1,000th career win
item.description: Cutter Gauthier scores the tiebreaking goal with 1:14 left and Leo Carlsson has a goal and two assists in his return for the Ducks, who erase a pair of two-goal deficits to help Quenneville become just the second NHL coach to reach the milestone.
